embed_token.title: Embed token
embed_token.description: A signed token that lets one widget or dashboard render on a named external website. Only the sha256 hash of the token is stored; the token itself is shown once.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name administrators know the token by.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the token is for and where it is embedded.

tokenHash.title: Token hash
tokenHash.description: The sha256 hash of the issued token, hex encoded. The token itself is never stored.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: What the token renders: {type: widget|dashboard, id, filterContext}.

type.title: Subject type
type.description: Whether the token renders one widget or a whole dashboard.

id.title: Subject id
id.description: The id of the widget or dashboard the token renders.

filterContext.title: Pinned filters
filterContext.description: Filters applied to every render; the host page cannot change them.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What the token may do: {mode: read|read-with-interactions, allowedFilters, allowedActions}.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: read shows the embed only; read-with-interactions also allows the actions listed in allowed actions.

allowedFilters.title: Allowed filters
allowedFilters.description: The filter fields the host page may set on top of the pinned filters.

allowedActions.title: Allowed actions
allowedActions.description: The interactions the embed may perform, such as drill-down or export.

hostOrigins.title: Host origins
hostOrigins.description: The origins allowed to frame the embed, scheme and host, never a wildcard.

tenantThemeId.title: Tenant theme
tenantThemeId.description: The tenant theme the embed is styled with; empty for the default look.

tokenExpiresAt.title: Expires at
tokenExpiresAt.description: Empty for a token that does not expire.

revokedAt.title: Revoked at
revokedAt.description: When the token was revoked; empty while it is valid.

revocationNotes.title: Revocation notes
revocationNotes.description: Free text the administrator added when revoking.

revokedBy.title: Revoked by
revokedBy.description: The user id of the administrator who revoked the token.

requestsPerMinute.title: Requests per minute
requestsPerMinute.description: How many render and data requests the token may make per minute.

burstSize.title: Burst size
burstSize.description: How many requests above the per-minute rate are allowed in a short burst.

keyId.title: Signing key id
keyId.description: The kid the token was signed with.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user id of the administrator who issued the token.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the token was last changed.

tenant_theme.title: Tenant theme
tenant_theme.description: CSS variables, a logo and :root-only custom CSS that make an embed match the host website.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name administrators know the theme by.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Custom property names (starting with --) and their values.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: The address of the logo shown in embeds with this theme.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user id of the administrator who created the theme.

embed_usage_event.title: Embed usage event
embed_usage_event.description: One request to an embed, without personal data: no IP address, no full user agent, no end-user identifier.

tokenId.title: Token
tokenId.description: The embed token the request came with.

hostOrigin.title: Host origin
hostOrigin.description: The origin of the page that framed the embed.

userAgent.title: Browser
userAgent.description: Browser family and major version only, for example Firefox 125.

userAgentHash.title: User agent hash
userAgentHash.description: sha256 of the full user agent string; the string itself is not kept.

viewportSize.title: Viewport
viewportSize.description: The size class of the embed frame.

responseStatusCode.title: Status code
responseStatusCode.description: The HTTP status LaunchPad answered with.

responseLatencyMs.title: Latency (ms)
responseLatencyMs.description: How long LaunchPad took to answer, in milliseconds.

correlationId.title: Correlation id
correlationId.description: The id that ties this event to its request in the logs.

embed_usage_event.x-openregister-demo-data: LaunchPad writes these as the record of embed requests it answered; sample rows would read as traffic that never happened.

signing_key.title: Signing key
signing_key.description: A key pair that signs embed tokens. The private key is stored encrypted; a retiring key still verifies the tokens it signed.

kid.title: Key id
kid.description: The key id that tokens name in their header.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: The signature algorithm of the key.

publicKeyJwk.title: Public key (JWK)
publicKeyJwk.description: The public key as a JSON Web Key, as published to hosts that verify tokens.

publicKeyPem.title: Public key (PEM)
publicKeyPem.description: The public key in PEM form.

privateKeyEncrypted.title: Private key (encrypted)
privateKeyEncrypted.description: The PEM private key, encrypted with the instance secret.

status.title: Status
status.description: active signs new tokens; retiring only verifies tokens it signed; revoked verifies nothing.

retiredAt.title: Retired at
retiredAt.description: When the key stopped signing new tokens; empty while it is active.

signing_key.x-openregister-demo-data: Signing keys are generated by LaunchPad and hold key material; demo rows would be keys nobody can verify against.
